notes.title: Lab Eject 6.0 Release Note
notes.content:
[h1]LabEject 6.0 Update Note[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
1. The Problem that Linux User cannot operate LabEject.exe has been fixed
2. The Problem that Floors that appear when you pull Lever disappear abnormaly has been fixed (Stage 10)

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
1. Now you cannot pull the Lever While you are in CutScene(Stage 10)
[b]2. Auto Achievement Check System is added[/b]
You dont need to Play or complete Stages for getting the Achievement that you already accomplished condition
3. New sprites are added for Steam Achievements

[h2]Balance Patch[/h2]
1. Stage 10's Gold/Silver/Copper Medal Condition are Changed

notes.title: Update Note For LabEject 5.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]LabEject 5.0 Update Note[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h3]
1. The Problem When Player die, Health Regenerator and Coin are not reset has been fixed 

[h3][b]New Feature[/b][/h3]
1. Now There is a Stage Clear Achievement on Steam
2. Golden Stage Clear Achievement has been added on Steam 

[h3][b]Balance Patch[/b][/h3]
1. None
